name: aerial
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for the side-scrolling game Encore. Input reference 1 is the existing Nige Hood parkour sprite atlas: preserve the exact same character identity, warm medium-brown skin, curly dark afro, short beard, olive-green jacket and matching relaxed pants, white undershirt and white sneakers, same rich hand-illustrated outlined game-art rendering. Reference 2 supports identity only. Create exactly SIX NEW full-body airborne poses facing SCREEN RIGHT in an evenly spaced THREE COLUMN by TWO ROW grid. Wide canvas 3:2 ratio, cell centers evenly spaced, generous transparent gutters between cells, no overlapping sprites, no labels or ground/shadow. Keep the character's physical head size/anatomy consistent between poses; all limbs and feet entirely in frame. TOP ROW left: upward spring before a front flip, arms driving forward and up, leading knee raised, trailing foot extended down. TOP ROW middle: forward somersault tuck ENTRY, torso angled forward, head forward/right, knees beginning to fold toward chest, both arms sweeping toward knees, still not upside down. TOP ROW right: UNFURL out of the tuck, torso upright angled right, arms opening for balance, feet extending below bent knees. BOTTOM ROW left: DOUBLE JUMP VERTICAL BOOST, strongly upward, both arms reaching overhead, torso tall, knees bent and feet underneath, looking upward/right. BOTTOM ROW middle: HIGH APEX, clearly different expressive high-in-air balancing silhouette, torso upright, arms stretched out diagonally for balance, knees softly bent, eyes looking down/right with mild surprise. BOTTOM ROW right: CONTROLLED DESCENT, both arms wide out to sides, legs reaching downward ready for landing, head looking slightly down/right with a relieved focused expression. Each pose should be readable at about 128 pixels character height. True transparent background with clean alpha edges; no colored backdrop, no checkerboard drawn into image, no UI, no text, no floor, no glow.

name: merch
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent item sprite atlas for a rich hand-illustrated 2D platform game. The provided golden crate is ONLY a rendering-style reference: bold clean dark contours, lovingly painted material detail, warm shading, readable at small size. Make exactly FOUR DIFFERENT isolated objects, neatly arranged in a TWO COLUMN by TWO ROW square grid with generous transparent gutters, one object centered within each quadrant, nothing overlapping. TOP LEFT: white short-sleeved crew-neck T-shirt, hanging naturally in a clear frontal view, subtle folds, big bold BLACK uppercase lettering exactly NH across the chest; no other lettering. TOP RIGHT: a white baseball cap in a slightly angled front view, black embroidered uppercase lettering exactly NH on the front crown, white bill, readable silhouette. BOTTOM LEFT: a special-edition black LP vinyl record with visible grooves partly slid out to the right of its dark teal sleeve; sleeve has a refined warm-gold border, bold gold NH, a small decorative hand-signature flourish near the bottom, tasteful sunburst art behind the NH, no other words. BOTTOM RIGHT: wooden merchandise SHIPPING CRATE, warm brown wood rather than gold, front face mostly square with slight top and right side showing, sturdy framing and two BLACK steel bands, a dark stenciled uppercase NH centered on the front, no glow, a visibly breakable wood object clearly distinct from the gold reference. Inventory/pickup sprite scale, very crisp, high quality illustrations, not photographs. White objects must be opaque white, not translucent. TRUE transparent background, clean alpha, no ground shadow, no labels, no UI, no fake checkerboard, no extra objects.
